$comment: Everything a run depends on. PREREG.md quotes this file; changing it after the preregistration commit voids the runs made under the old one.

prices.$comment: USD per million tokens, from https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing as read on 2026-11-17. Checked again on the day of each phase; a change is recorded in PREREG.md before the phase starts.

egress.$comment: An allowed host invalidates a task only when its failure persists: no successful connection in the session's window, or failures for at least this many minutes with no success between them. The same for both arms.

$comment_runStartMarginUsd: A run starts only if the phase cap covers its three task budgets plus this slack ($3 per task) for one-turn overruns, so that no task is skipped for want of cap.
